software_attribution.head: e29cc1163ff9ce3cd73833c15eb24611941bac34
software_attribution.scope: Read-only exact Gitblob/ELF attribution; no execution or relabeling of software tests.

private_disk2.scope: Private application disk2 only. Existing helper tracked disk2 is separately audited; TLS configs/manifest/IPC remain1. No v2 heartbeat observation is inferred from raw-v1 runs.

facts.operation_cleanup_distinction: Old HID client retained operation_error=io with verified cleanup; SIGKILL old serial has no completed operation return, and null operation_error is not a success claim.
facts.local_gone_evidence: Observed VHCI NULL, old-address kernel disconnect, exact native_import_released proof and archived successful guest absence assertion. No standalone sysfs-tree absence dump was captured.
facts.pending_urb_scope: Serial tty FD4 was closed after round2 before SIGKILL. Connected/held-capability death is demonstrated; no claim a specific URB or ioctl was pending at the signal.

actual_configuration.scope: Actual post-startup guest public JSON/DER/pin bytes and path ownership metadata are captured in both epochs; private key content was neither exported nor independently hashed. This does not independently decrypt PCAP or attest private-key bytes.

limits: Assertion counts are audit comparisons, not USB cases.
Only supplied completed dataset audited; no QEMU, Cargo, build, product executable, USB operation or repository edit.
PCAP originals are hash-checked only here; this lifecycle report does not independently establish TLS packet classification.
Reuses the cb08672 actual public configuration/pin/metadata parser; all historical scripts/reports remain unchanged. Private key bytes remain deliberately uncollected.
No physical hardware, virtual/USBFS managed path, full Phase3 completion, performance, or pending-URB crash claim.

reuse.changes: e29cc11 source/ELF and local software-manifest provenance; added strict private application disk2/association/raw-v1/unchanged DTO checks; all prior lifecycle/configuration assertions retained.
